integrity: The result is fully specified by a self-contained analytical proof and directly replayable finite-state checks. Numerical checks are not offered as an all-size proof. Prior contributions, including the all-state four-vertex example, are explicitly acknowledged.
limitations: Proof treats only the forward cyclic scan on finite simple cycles of at least three vertices with the precise up/down thresholds (1,3); no extensions to other scan orders or stochastic dynamics are asserted. Unindexed literature may contain equivalent results.
title: Binary-necklace attractors and triangular-run basins for sequential bi-threshold cycles
